products.name: Studio Cap
products.subtitle: Six-panel embroidered cap
products.description: A clean six-panel cap in washed cotton twill with a low-profile crown and a small tonal logo embroidered on the front.
products.details: Cut from heavyweight brushed cotton twill that breaks in beautifully and holds its shape. The curved brim is pre-shaped, the crown sits low, and an antique-brass slider strap on the back dials in the fit. Subtle tonal embroidery keeps it understated enough to wear with anything.
products.materials: 100% brushed cotton twill, antique-brass adjustable strap.

products.name: Ribbed Beanie
products.subtitle: Cuffed merino-blend beanie
products.description: A soft ribbed beanie knitted from a merino blend, with a deep fold-up cuff that sits just right.
products.details: Knitted in a fine 2x2 rib from a merino-acrylic blend that stays warm without itching. The double-layer cuff can be worn folded for a snug skull fit or rolled down for more coverage. A wardrobe staple in a quiet, year-round palette.
products.dimensions: One size, stretches to fit most.

products.name: Everyday Tee
products.subtitle: Heavyweight organic cotton tee
products.description: A heavyweight organic cotton tee with a relaxed boxy cut and a ribbed crew neck that keeps its shape.
products.details: Built from 240gsm organic cotton with a dense, structured handfeel that drapes without clinging. The body is cut slightly boxy with dropped shoulders, and the collar is double-stitched so it won't go slack after washing. Garment-dyed for a soft, lived-in colour from day one.

products.name: Leather Wallet
products.subtitle: Compact vegetable-tanned bifold
products.description: A slim bifold wallet in vegetable-tanned leather that ages into a rich patina, with room for the cards you actually carry.
products.details: Cut from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather and saddle-stitched by hand at the edges. Four card slots, a hidden pocket and a folded note section keep things tidy without the bulk. The leather starts firm and pale, then softens and darkens with use so no two wallets wear the same.

products.name: Phone Case
products.subtitle: Shock-absorbing matte iPhone case
products.description: A slim, matte iPhone case with a soft-touch finish and raised edges that protect the screen and camera.
products.details: A flexible shock-absorbing shell with a soft-touch matte coating that resists fingerprints and grip-slip. Raised lips around the screen and camera keep both off the table, and the precise cut-outs leave every button and port easy to reach. Wireless-charging friendly, so it stays on the phone.
products.materials: Recycled TPU shell, soft-touch matte coating.

products.name: Canvas Tote
products.subtitle: Heavy cotton-canvas everyday tote
products.description: A roomy everyday tote in heavy natural cotton canvas, built to carry a laptop, a sketchbook and the rest of it.
products.details: Made from 16oz natural cotton canvas that stands up on its own and softens with use. Reinforced webbing handles are bar-tacked at the stress points, there is an internal slip pocket for keys and cables, and a flat base keeps it stable when you set it down. Screen-printed with a small studio mark.
products.materials: 16oz natural cotton canvas, reinforced webbing handles.
